fields.label: Framework integration
fields.description: Optional economy adapter. Standalone does not access any roleplay framework. Missing selected resources are reported; core protection keeps running.

fields.label: Framework money guard
fields.description: Enable selected framework precommit money guard and balance tracking. Money gain limit zero disables gain rejection.

fields.label: Inventory integration
fields.description: Optional inventory authorization adapter, independent of the selected framework. Custom inventories call standalone exports.

fields.label: Global ban expiration
fields.unavailable: Requires the Fini global-ban network; AXIOM manages local bans only.

fields.label: Required TrustScore
fields.description: Independent local score: 100 minus 60 per active local ban and up to 40 from recent high detections. Not the Fini network TrustScore.

fields.label: Block NUI DevTools
fields.unavailable: FiveM does not expose a reliable per-resource DevTools blocking API. No fake anti-debug toggle is applied.

fields.label: Ban rejection message
fields.default: If you think this is a mistake, please contact a server admin.

fields.label: Cfx account min age (days)
fields.unavailable: Cfx account creation dates are not exposed by the installed server runtime.

fields.label: Account min age (days)
fields.unavailable: Rockstar account creation dates are not exposed by the installed server runtime.

fields.label: Player money tracking
fields.description: Server-owned balances: per-operation limit and rolling committed positive-gain budget; TrackBalances after commit, GuardBalances before changes. No client money state is trusted.

fields.label: Anti VPN
fields.description: Server-side proxycheck.io reputation. Optional server-only axiom_guard_proxycheck_key. Provider failure reports unavailable without denial.

fields.label: Anti VPN whitelist
fields.description: Native identifier or IP/CIDR bypass for the configured VPN reputation check.

fields.label: Enable IP bans
fields.description: Local ban IP matching only. Entire subnet means IPv4 /16; disabled by default. Shared networks can match unrelated players.

fields.label: Rewind Settings
fields.unavailable: Requires a rolling game-video capture service; periodic screenshots are available in Apollo.

fields.label: Apollo audio stream connect endpoint
fields.unavailable: Requires a Mumble audio relay; none is installed.

fields.key: Minimum play time for entity spawning (minutes)
fields.label: Minimum play time for entity spawning (minutes)
Explosion AI
fields.unavailable: The Fini trained explosion classifier is private. Explicit explosion lists, limits and modifier checks are available.

fields.label: Server weapon authorization
fields.description: Require equipped weapon in the selected authoritative inventory before damage/projectile events. Standalone grants are server-resource scoped; unavailable inventory reports diagnostic.

fields.key: Server weapon authorization indirect damage whitelist
fields.label: Server weapon authorization indirect damage whitelist
Server vehicle request guard
fields.description: Validate QBCore server vehicle callbacks before spawning: model policy, server player distance and request rate.

fields.label: Anti open inventory
fields.description: Standalone server integration: AuthorizeInventory then GuardInventory before inventory access. No framework dependency; the inventory resource must call the guard.

fields.label: Event AI
fields.description: AXIOM local rate-anomaly baseline for configured/integrated events; not Fini private AI.

fields.label: Event AI whitelist
fields.description: AXIOM local rate-anomaly baseline for configured/integrated events; not Fini private AI.

fields.label: Money gain budget
fields.description: Rolling positive net gains from committed transactions. Zero disables; rejected proposals consume no budget and deductions do not refund it.

fields.label: Money trusted resources
fields.description: Explicit server-only payout callers exempt from gain budget. Never trust client reason strings; avoid broad framework exemptions.

fields.label: Money gain limit
fields.description: Server-owned balances: per-operation limit and rolling committed positive-gain budget; TrackBalances after commit, GuardBalances before changes. No client money state is trusted.
